mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history ( point_history_no, member_no, amount, pointTransactionCode, point_transaction_reson_code, point_transaction_reson_no, start_date_time, end_date_time, upper_point_history_no, remain_point, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time ) VALUES ( #{pointHistoryNo}, #{memberNo}, #{amount,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{pointTransactionCode}, #{pointTransactionResonCode}, #{pointTransactionResonNo}, #{startDateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{endDateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{upperPointHistoryNo}, #{remainPoint,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{registId}, #{registDateTime}, #{modifyId}, #{modifyDateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT point_history_no, member_no, amount, pointTransactionCode, point_transaction_reson_code, point_transaction_reson_no, start_date_time, end_date_time, upper_point_history_no, remain_point, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM point_history WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY regist_date_time DESC

SELECT point_history_no, member_no, amount, pointTransactionCode, point_transaction_reson_code, point_transaction_reson_no, start_date_time, end_date_time, upper_point_history_no, remain_point, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM point_history WHERE point_history_no = #{pointHistoryNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE point_history SET member_no = #{memberNo}, amount = #{amount,jdbcType=BIGINT}, pointTransactionCode = #{pointTransactionCode}, point_transaction_reson_code = #{pointTransactionResonCode}, point_transaction_reson_no = #{pointTransactionResonNo}, start_date_time = #{startDateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, end_date_time = #{endDateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, upper_point_history_no = #{upperPointHistoryNo}, remain_point = #{remainPoint,jdbcType=BIGINT}, modify_id = #{modifyId}, modify_date_time = #{modifyDateTime} WHERE point_history_no = #{pointHistoryNo}
mapper.select: SELECT point_history_no, member_no, amount, point_transaction_code, point_transaction_reson_code, point_transaction_reson_no, start_date_time, end_date_time, upper_point_history_no, remain_point, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM point_history WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} AND remain_point > 0 AND end_date_time >= NOW() ORDER BY end_date_time ASC, regist_date_time ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remain_point), 0) FROM point_history WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} AND remain_point > 0 AND end_date_time >= NOW()
